summary: Two Criticals in the enforcement mechanism; the core thesis is sound and unusually well evidenced. (1) The suite is inert in the CI jobs it targets: the parity suites run in loops-routing and version-gates, neither of which sets fetch-depth, so actions/checkout's default depth-1 leaves origin/main unresolvable and `git diff origin/main...HEAD` exits 128. The proposed silent working-tree fallback then inspects zero lines and reports green on every PR. This repository has both the prior art (975f37f3 / d7551291) and the visible-skip convention. (2) The line-granular escape clause exempts lines that still carry a live defect: check-task-state.ps1:116 carried -cmatch beside two bare -eq comparisons that diverged from the awk twin — a divergence confirmed live and fixed separately during this cycle. Also: replayed over the reference commit the token list yields 21 findings and 0 true positives; registration needs three surfaces, not one; the marker hatch is unaudited; and no cheaper alternative was weighed.
